title: docs: re-measure the example CRM size on the four pages that state it (31 files, 1,929 lines, ~18.5k tokens)
body:
Fixes #22248
Clause-②: no

## What this changes

Four content pages state the size of the bundled example CRM (`examples/app-crm`) as 31 files, 1,792 lines, about 16k tokens, about 8% of a 200k-token window. The concepts page prints the command that reproduces the line count and invites the reader to run it ("Count it yourself"). Run against this PR's base it answers 1,929, not 1,792.

This PR re-measures the figure with the page's own command and re-derives the token and percentage estimates by the method the original figure was made with. Only the figures change; nothing else on any page does.

| Page | Location | Before | After |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `content/docs/concepts/metadata-driven.mdx` | table, section 4 | Lines 1,792 · ~16,000 tokens · "about 8%" | Lines 1,929 · ~18,500 tokens · "about 9%" |
| `content/blog/context-window-is-the-constraint.mdx` | table + next sentence | Lines 1,792 · ~16,000 tokens · "about 8%" | Lines 1,929 · ~18,500 tokens · "about 9%" |
| `content/docs/getting-started/how-ai-development-works.mdx` | prose, "Why it's fast" | "1,792 lines across 31 files, about 16k tokens" | "1,929 lines across 31 files, about 18.5k tokens" |
| `content/blog/the-ontology-is-the-software.mdx` | prose, one sentence | "31 files and roughly sixteen thousand tokens" | "31 files and roughly 18,500 tokens" |

The file count (31) is unchanged and still correct on all four.

### The fourth page

The card names three pages. A grep of the whole tracked tree (release notes and CHANGELOGs, which record history, excluded; case-insensitive; every spelling of the line, token and percentage figures) found one more restatement of the same measurement inside `content/**`: the ontology post, which says "roughly sixteen thousand tokens" for the same 31 files. Left alone it would contradict the three corrected pages by 13%, so it is part of this card (nothing outside `content/**` carries the figures; the root README already carries the command only, with no number). No open PR touches any of the four files (10 open PRs' file lists read at base).

## Measured at the PR's base

Base: `origin/main` 3513ac77814f5e6eb530c7b92e4797b4ae6b5e0a, in this PR's worktree. `origin/main` has since moved to 9f0de32a03629a021836d9216dbca86ccdc645f3; the diff between the two over `examples/app-crm/src` and the four pages is empty, so the figures hold at the tip as well.

```text
$ find examples/app-crm/src -name '*.ts' -not -name '*.test.ts' | xargs cat | wc -l
1929
$ find examples/app-crm/src -name '*.ts' -not -name '*.test.ts' | wc -l
31
$ find examples/app-crm/src -name '*.ts' -not -name '*.test.ts' | xargs cat | wc -c
73889
```

### How the token and percentage figures were re-derived

Neither page states how tokens were estimated, so the method was recovered from the figure's origin rather than assumed. The page figure was first written in the commit that added the context-window post (parent tree `a6058728de00816279204adb6579ba6797a156e0`). Counting that tree with the same command, filters and glob gives:

```text
a6058728: 31 files, 1,792 lines, 63,993 bytes   63,993 / 4 = 15,998  ->  "~16,000";  16,000 / 200,000 = 8%
```

So the method is **bytes divided by 4** (the repo's own rule of thumb, as in `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`), not a fixed tokens-per-line ratio. The same method reproduces the post's other two figures at that tree: the Todo example (25 files, 58,255 bytes, 14,564, "~14.5k") and the showcase (83 files, 405,447 bytes, 101,362, "~101k").

Applied at this base:

```text
73,889 bytes / 4 = 18,472   ->  "~18,500" (nearest 500, the precision the post already uses for "~14.5k")
18,500 / 200,000 = 9.25%    ->  "about 9%"
```

A fixed per-line ratio (1,929 x 16,000/1,792 = 17,223) would have understated it: the average line grew from 35.7 to 38.3 bytes.

## Verification

Docs-only, no executable code. The gate list was derived from the actual diff at the head commit with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no path arguments; 4 paths against merge base 3513ac778), every command run with its exit code recorded to a file before any pipe, and the record reconciled with `--ran`:

```text
✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 40 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 40 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 40 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3).
```

All 40 exit 0 at head 35744bd25ba23638407ddf7bb6d908d4b37b9852 (including `check:docs-single-h1`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:doc-anchors`, `check:docs-transcript-drift`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:corpus-claim-drift`, the doc-frontmatter and doc-route-spelling gates and their self-tests). Five of them (`check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:doc-security-posture`, `check:docs`, `check:skill-examples`, `check:docs-transcript-drift`) first refused on a fresh worktree because their built inputs did not exist (exit 3, or exit 1 for the missing `packages/spec/json-schema`); the first-pass record was kept, the dependency closures were built (`@objectstack/lint...` and `@objectstack/client-react...`, under the shared verify lock) and those five were re-run and exit 0. A refusal to measure is not a finding and is not counted as a pass.

No changeset: no published package ships `content/**` (69 non-private `package.json` files scanned; none references the root `content/` tree in `files` or `scripts`; the same pattern matches a known-true control string). The PR carries `skip-changeset`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Sibling figures on the context-window post are stale by the same method and are not touched.** The post's next paragraph says "The Todo example is ~14.5k tokens. The kitchen-sink showcase app ... 83 files of it ... is ~101k. Even that one ... leaves half a modern context window free". At this base, bytes / 4 gives Todo 27 files, 95,787 bytes, ~23.9k tokens; showcase 91 files, 695,310 bytes, ~173.8k tokens, which leaves about 13% of a 200k window, not half. The card says whether that post gets a fuller rewrite is a separate maintainer decision, and "nothing else on the pages changes", so this is reported, not edited.
- **The figure will drift again** with every change to `examples/app-crm/src`. The card names no gate and none is added.
- **The pages do not say how tokens were estimated.** Left as is under the same "nothing else changes" clause; the method is recorded above for the next person to re-derive.
